_note: 批次B1(用户在洛杉矶实地反馈:砸车盗窃高频,要 911 报警 + 保险理赔)。①emergency-call 补 entry/intermediate/advanced 三档,现有 beginner(车祸叫救护车)不动;②新场景 car-breakin「车被砸·车内失窃」4档;③新场景 insurance-claim「保险理赔」4档。遵循 docs/日常场景内容生产检查清单:一档=一条连贯叙事线;entry 是最简活命句(可与 beginner 核心动作重合,但更短);台词表形态只写学员自己的话;美式英语+洛杉矶真实流程(LAPD theft-from-vehicle 可网上报案且需 DR number、comprehensive 才赔车窗、deductible 常高于损失、glass coverage 可能零免赔、车内私人物品多由 renter's/homeowner's 保险管、报案影响保费)。安全优先:正在发生的犯罪不靠近不对峙、留在安全处、地址先说。

entry.zh: 我在第三街和主街路口。

intermediate.en: I'd like to report a car break-in.
intermediate.zh: 我要报案，我的车被撬了。

intermediate.en: I'm in the parking lot at Third and Main.
intermediate.zh: 我在第三街和主街的停车场。

intermediate.en: It just happened — maybe ten minutes ago.
intermediate.zh: 刚刚发生的——大概十分钟前。

intermediate.en: My window is smashed and my backpack is gone.
intermediate.zh: 我的车窗被砸了，背包不见了。

intermediate.en: No one is hurt.
intermediate.zh: 没有人受伤。

intermediate.en: I didn't see who did it.
intermediate.zh: 我没看到是谁干的。

intermediate.en: There's broken glass all over the ground.
intermediate.zh: 地上到处都是碎玻璃。

intermediate.en: Should I wait here for an officer?
intermediate.zh: 我需要在这儿等警察吗？

intermediate.en: My number is 213-555-0142.

advanced.en: I need police right now — someone is breaking into a car in this lot.
advanced.zh: 我现在需要警察——有人正在这个停车场撬车。

advanced.en: I'm at the market on Third and Vermont, and it's happening right now.
advanced.zh: 我在第三街和佛蒙特街的超市，正在发生。

advanced.en: He's still there, next to a silver sedan near the back.
advanced.zh: 他还在，就在后面一辆银色轿车旁边。

advanced.en: I'm inside the store — I haven't gone out there.
advanced.zh: 我在店里——我没有出去。

advanced.en: He's a man in a black hoodie, maybe thirty years old.
advanced.zh: 是个穿黑色连帽衫的男的，大概三十岁。

advanced.en: I can't tell if he has a weapon, and I'm not going any closer.
advanced.zh: 我看不出他有没有武器，我也不会再靠近。

advanced.en: Other people are walking by, but no one has gone near him.
advanced.zh: 有人路过，但没人靠近他。

advanced.en: I'll keep watching from the window and tell you if he leaves.
advanced.zh: 我会从窗户继续看着，他要是走了我告诉你。

advanced.en: He's just moved toward the back of the lot on foot.
advanced.zh: 他刚往停车场后面走过去了，是步行。

advanced.en: Yes, I can stay on the line until the officers get here.
advanced.zh: 可以，我会一直不挂，直到警察到。

advanced.en: I'll wave to them from the front door so they can find me.
advanced.zh: 我会在前门朝他们招手，好让他们找到我。

meta.title: 车被砸·车内失窃
meta.subtitle: Car break-in
meta.description: 洛杉矶最高频的一种案子：回到车前发现车窗被砸、包被拿走。报警、拿 DR 编号、叫玻璃上门修。
learn: 现场怎么说（不碰玻璃、先拍照）
车内失窃可以网上报案，也能让警察来
问 DR 编号给保险公司
叫上门修玻璃、问工期与价格

entry.en: I need to call the police.

beginner.en: Excuse me, did you see what happened to my car?
beginner.zh: 打扰一下，你看到我的车怎么了吗？
副驾驶那侧的车窗被砸碎了。

beginner.en: My backpack was on the seat, and now it's gone.
beginner.zh: 我的背包本来在座位上，现在不见了。

beginner.en: I parked here about two hours ago.
beginner.zh: 我大概两小时前停在这儿的。

beginner.en: There's glass everywhere — I haven't touched anything.
beginner.zh: 到处都是玻璃——我什么都没碰。

beginner.en: I'm taking photos before I clean it up.
Are there security cameras in this lot?
beginner.zh: 这个停车场有监控摄像头吗？

beginner.en: Thanks — I'm going to call the police now.

intermediate.en: Hi, I need to report a theft from my vehicle.
intermediate.zh: 你好，我要报案，我的车里东西被偷了。

intermediate.en: It's at the public lot on Third and Main, in Los Angeles.
intermediate.zh: 在洛杉矶第三街和主街的公共停车场。

intermediate.en: The window was smashed and a backpack was taken.
intermediate.zh: 车窗被砸，一个背包被拿走了。

intermediate.en: No one was in the car, and nobody was hurt.
intermediate.zh: 车里没有人，也没有人受伤。

intermediate.en: I don't know who did it, and I didn't see anyone.
intermediate.zh: 我不知道是谁干的，也没看到任何人。

intermediate.en: Can I file this online, or does an officer need to come out?
intermediate.zh: 这个能网上报案吗，还是需要警察出警？

intermediate.en: The laptop inside has a serial number — I have it written down.
intermediate.zh: 里面的笔记本电脑有序列号——我记下来了。

intermediate.en: Could you give me the DR number for the report?
intermediate.zh: 能给我这次报案的 DR 编号吗？

intermediate.en: My insurance company will ask for that, right?
intermediate.zh: 我的保险公司会要这个编号，对吗？

advanced.en: Hi, my car window was smashed last night — do you do mobile glass repair?
advanced.zh: 你好，我的车窗昨晚被砸了——你们上门修玻璃吗？

advanced.en: It's the front passenger window on a 2019 Honda CR-V.
advanced.zh: 是一辆 2019 款本田 CR-V 的前排副驾驶车窗。

advanced.en: The car is drivable, but there's still glass in the door and the seats.
advanced.zh: 车还能开，但门里和座椅上还有玻璃碴。

advanced.en: Does the price include vacuuming the glass out?
advanced.zh: 报价包含把玻璃碴吸干净吗？

advanced.en: Is that quote for OEM glass or aftermarket?
advanced.zh: 这个报价是原厂玻璃还是副厂的？

advanced.en: My policy may have glass coverage — could you bill the insurance directly?
advanced.zh: 我的保单可能含玻璃险——你们能直接跟保险公司结算吗？

advanced.en: If I pay out of pocket instead, what's the total with tax?
advanced.zh: 如果我自己付，含税总共多少钱？

advanced.en: How soon could someone come out to my address?
advanced.zh: 最快什么时候能派人到我这儿？

advanced.en: Do I need to be there the whole time, or just to hand over the keys?
advanced.zh: 我需要全程在场吗，还是把钥匙交给你们就行？

advanced.en: Is there a warranty on the glass and the installation?
advanced.zh: 玻璃和安装有保修吗？

advanced.en: Great — let's book it for tomorrow morning.
advanced.zh: 好的——就约明天上午吧。

meta.title: 保险理赔
meta.subtitle: Filing an insurance claim
meta.description: 车被砸、东西被偷、出了事故之后打给保险公司：报案拿 claim 号、问免赔额、约定损、租车、修理厂。
learn: 报案说清时间地点与损失
租车怎么算、理赔会不会涨保费

entry.en: I want to report a claim.

beginner.en: Hi, I'd like to file a claim on my auto policy.
beginner.zh: 你好，我想用我的车险报一个理赔。

beginner.en: My policy number is on my card — let me read it to you.
beginner.zh: 保单号在我的卡上——我念给你听。

beginner.en: Someone broke my car window and took a backpack.
beginner.zh: 有人砸了我的车窗，拿走了一个背包。

beginner.en: It happened last night in a parking lot.
beginner.zh: 是昨晚在一个停车场发生的。

beginner.en: I already filed a police report.
I have the report number right here.
I also took photos of the damage.

intermediate.en: Hi, I'm calling to follow up on a claim I opened yesterday.
intermediate.zh: 你好，我想跟进一下我昨天报的理赔。

intermediate.en: The claim number is 4-8-2-6-1.
Is this covered under comprehensive, or do I need something else?
intermediate.zh: 这个走综合险能赔吗，还是需要别的险种？

intermediate.en: What's my deductible on this one?
intermediate.zh: 这一项我的免赔额是多少？

intermediate.en: If the repair costs less than that, is it still worth filing?
intermediate.zh: 如果修车费比免赔额还低，还值得走理赔吗？

intermediate.en: The backpack and laptop were inside the car — are those covered too?
intermediate.zh: 背包和笔记本电脑在车里——这些也赔吗？

intermediate.en: When will the adjuster contact me?
intermediate.zh: 定损员什么时候联系我？

intermediate.en: Can I use my own repair shop, or does it have to be one of yours?
intermediate.zh: 我能用自己找的修理厂吗，还是必须用你们指定的？

intermediate.en: Could you email me a summary of everything we just went over?
intermediate.zh: 能把我们刚才谈的内容整理成邮件发我吗？

advanced.en: Hi, I'd like to go over the estimate the adjuster sent me.
advanced.zh: 你好，我想跟你核对一下定损员发给我的估价单。

advanced.en: The shop quoted me four hundred more than what's on your estimate.
advanced.zh: 修理厂给我的报价比你们的估价单高出四百美元。

advanced.en: They said the difference is because your estimate used aftermarket glass.
advanced.zh: 他们说差价是因为你们的估价用的是副厂玻璃。

advanced.en: Could you have the adjuster call the shop directly to work that out?
advanced.zh: 能让定损员直接跟修理厂沟通解决吗？

advanced.en: While it's in the shop, does my policy cover a rental car?
advanced.zh: 车在修理厂期间，我的保单包含租车吗？

advanced.en: What's the daily limit, and how many days does it cover?
advanced.zh: 每天的限额是多少？总共能覆盖几天？

advanced.en: I'd rather not file for the stolen items if it's going to raise my premium.
advanced.zh: 如果会让我的保费上涨，被偷的物品那部分我宁可不报。

advanced.en: Could you tell me how this claim will affect my rate at renewal?
advanced.zh: 能告诉我这次理赔会怎么影响我续保时的费率吗？

advanced.en: If I decide to withdraw part of the claim, is that possible?
advanced.zh: 如果我决定撤回理赔中的一部分，可以吗？

advanced.en: Please make a note that I want to be called, not emailed, about next steps.
advanced.zh: 请备注一下，后续进展我希望电话通知，不要邮件。

advanced.en: Thanks — could you send me that in writing today?
advanced.zh: 谢谢——今天能把这些用书面形式发给我吗？
